easy.def: A hard, creamy-white stuff from the tusks of an elephant.

more.def: The hard, creamy-white material that the tusks of elephants are made of; also a creamy-white color.
examples: Piano keys were once made from ivory.
Ivory comes from the tusks of elephants, so it is not used much anymore.
She wore an ivory dress to the wedding.

easy.def: A green plant that climbs up walls.

more.def: A climbing plant with shiny leaves that grows up walls and trees.
examples: Thick ivy climbed up the side of the old brick school.
Ivy leaves have a pointed shape like a star.
The ivy crept across the garden wall.
